scope: S3/S4 engineering hypothesis verification, NOT physiology or behavior

lower_bound_proof.domain: Reset-origin finite V=-65; original nonnegative conductance increments; gE,gI,gA>=0; finite I>=0; fixed positive C,dt,gL; unmutated threshold/reset and parameters.
lower_bound_proof.induction: All reversal potentials >=-80; gA term is zero at L. Exact positive decays, nonnegative spike increment and source weights preserve g>=0. Reset/refractory=-65 preserves bound. Unspiked active V<-50 and spiked reset=-65 imply poststep V<=-50.
lower_bound_proof.caveat: Real-arithmetic proof, numerical residuals checked separately. Arbitrary public state mutation and nonfinite arithmetic are outside domain. Bound is not physiological calibration.

limitations: 100ms independent saved-input traces do not replace parent 200ms acceptance or full1817bin trace.
No physical steps or training; hypothesis not calibrated physiology.
Randomized initial state/queue is a separate numerical threshold diagnostic, not measured biology.
Public arbitrary voltage/parameter mutation is outside proof domain; guard tests cover exposed current roles, current finite/sign and finite/nonnegative conductances.
Historical current-adaptation voltage failure below -90mV is retained and not reclassified.
